verseText: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
meaning: The Lord God is the King of all creation. In heaven, he sits on his throne and rules over everything he has made.

recall.question: Where has the LORD placed His throne?
choices: On the surface of the sun

meaning.question: A throne is the place where a king rules from. What does it mean that God’s kingdom “rules over all”?
choices: He is in charge of everyone
He has a really large throne

application.prompt: Sometimes things happen that you cannot control or understand. Even duriing confusing times, God is still King over everything, and you can trust that He is still in control. When was a time you needed to remember that God was still on His throne?
